input.quote: 14.2 Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
input.rationale: § 14.2 gives Vendor exclusive ownership of Deliverables that, per the § 1.4 definition, are work product "created specifically for Customer" (and expressly exclude Vendor Technology and Vendor know-how), while leaving us only a revocable, non-transferable licence limited to the Order Form term. That inverts the playbook position that we own what we pay for, and the revocable term licence means we lose access to our own bespoke reports, configurations and integrations at expiry. §§ 14.1 and 15.1 correctly leave Customer Data and Customer IP with us, § 14.3 properly preserves Vendor Technology with the perpetual § 13.2 licence-back, and § 14.4 disclaims joint ownership — so the only defect is the ownership direction in § 14.2. Redline vests Deliverable ownership in Customer with a present assignment, expressly preserving Vendor's retained Vendor Technology rights under § 14.3; fallback (perpetual, irrevocable § 13.2-style licence over the whole Deliverable) is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Reverse § 14.2 so Customer owns paid-for Deliverables, with Vendor assignment and Vendor Technology carve-out preserved.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We must own the work product we pay Vendor to create for us, so we have reversed § 14.2 to vest ownership of Deliverables in Customer with a present assignment from Vendor; a revocable, term-limited licence to our own paid-for Deliverables is not acceptable. Vendor's retained rights in Vendor Technology are unaffected (§ 14.3 and the perpetual § 13.2 licence). If Vendor cannot assign, our fallback is Vendor ownership of generic tools only, with the perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, sublicensable § 13.2 licence extended to the entire Deliverable.

ops.oldText: 14.2 Vendor exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer. Customer receives a revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term.
ops.newText: 14.2 Customer exclusively owns every Deliverable created for Customer, and Vendor hereby irrevocably assigns to Customer all right, title, and interest (including all intellectual property rights) in each Deliverable upon creation, subject only to Vendor's retained rights in Vendor Technology under Section 14.3.
